versions.content: If the start of a new physical request (SF or FF) is received while transmission of a previously trigger ed physical request is ongoing, the LIN Interface shall abort the ongoing transmission. If the NAD matches the configured NAD of the slave node or the broadcast NAD, the LIN Interface shall accept the new physical request .
